# Pull Request

Use a Conventional Commit title: `<type>: <description>` or `<type>(<scope>): <description>`. Allowed types: `feat`, `fix`, `chore`, `docs`, `test`, and `refactor`.

## 1. Work item

- Execution bead:
- GitHub issue or decision:
- Atomically bundled beads: None
- Why these beads must land together: Not applicable

## 2. Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## 3. Scope

- [ ] This pull request covers one execution bead or an identified atomic bundle.
- [ ] Unrelated cleanup and dependency changes are excluded.
- [ ] Required dependency changes are explained below, or there are none.

## 4. Dependency changes

None.

## 5. Verification

List each command and its result.

- [ ] `composer ci:check`

## 6. Review notes

Call out risks, deferred work, environment limitations, and reviewer focus areas. Write `None` when there are none.
